notes: A claim can answer 503 although it landed (the 0.55 s run: the route timed out in the old holder's cleanup after the claim write succeeded). The client retries on 503, and a retried claim of a role the session already holds is idempotent.

Between a late-landing claim and the reaper's second pass (up to ~10 minutes), the old holder's interest record still lists the role topic, so GET /v1/sessions reports that role on it. Role delivery reads the claim, not the topic.

A session subscribed straight to notifications.role.<role> without holding its claim now loses that topic after two reaper passes; no client in this repository subscribes that way (envoy-client's topic guide says role topics are publish-to, claimed through envoy_role_set).
